fusions.name: Shaken Ceiling
fusions.desc: Your shriek brings jagged rock down in a cone 5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 30 rock damage that ignores armour to everything in it.

fusions.name: Off the Cave Wall
fusions.desc: Sends a click into the first enemy in its path for 4 resonating damage; it rebounds to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that.

fusions.name: Cave-Skin Jink
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds and moves you 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Echo Through Rock
fusions.desc: Your resonating damage cannot be resisted.
